detections.text: Two land rights decided. One still open.
detections.subject: land rights

detections.text: DNR approved a 50-year North Slope data center lease and, on November 10th, published its decision conveying about 6,800 acres near Houston to AIDEA. Its proposed decision on Alaska LNG's 800-mile corridor still takes comment.
detections.subject: acres

detections.text: DNR cites planned capitalization of more than $50 billion and letters of intent for more than 60 percent of capacity, which it calls non-binding. The Department of Revenue's economics analysis is confidential. Per ADN, Crowther acknowledged departing from DNR's normal process.
detections.subject: billion and letters

detections.text: 6,800 acres to AIDEA. The borough wants it elsewhere.
detections.subject: acres

detections.text: DNR's decision conveys about 6,800 acres, down from almost 20,000 first proposed. On November 13th the Mat-Su Borough asked DNR to reconsider and named Point MacKenzie.
detections.subject: acres

detections.text: North Slope, a 50-year lease on about 715 acres for a 1 to 3 gigawatt data center, drew more than 1,200 responses, most opposed. Houston drew more than 2,300 comments, almost all opposed. Each decision now has a reconsideration window.
